text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry... I've had 
a headache since this morning...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...E-Ehehe... Doing things like this 
somehow feels kind of grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Augh... But still, I really don't like 
pain...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Nishino Flower's headache 
refused to go away easily...
